gui.shinobiextras.title: Extra Jutsus
gui.shinobiextras.hint: Click to learn (XP) or select. Z uses, X cycles, K opens this screen.
message.shinobiextras.none_learned: You haven't learned any extra jutsu yet (press K).
message.shinobiextras.no_target: No target or point in sight.
jutsu.shinobiextras.kirigakure.desc: Mist that blinds and slows nearby enemies for 15 s and speeds you up.
jutsu.shinobiextras.nikudan_sensha.desc: Rolling charge: resistance and heavy damage to anything in the path.
jutsu.shinobiextras.gatsuuga.desc: Spinning charge that hits anything in the path multiple times.
jutsu.shinobiextras.shikotsumyaku.desc: Bone spikes burst from the ground at the aimed spot, hurting and launching enemies.
jutsu.shinobiextras.kikaichu.desc: Insects poison and weaken the target. Against players, they drain chakra.
jutsu.shinobiextras.bakuha.desc: Marks a point: explodes after 2 s hurting nearby targets (no block damage).
jutsu.shinobiextras.samehada.desc: Close-range strike that hurts the target, heals you and steals chakra from players.
jutsu.shinobiextras.chidori_nagashi.desc: 8 s electric aura: hurts and pushes back anyone close. Grants resistance.
jutsu.shinobiextras.shunshin.desc: Short forward teleport (up to 12 blocks) in the blink of an eye.
dialog.shinobiextras.zabuza: A shinobi is a tool. Nothing more.
dialog.shinobiextras.kimimaro: I will live for Lord Orochimaru.
dialog.shinobiextras.rock_lee: A genius of hard work never gives up!
